entries.notes: Key resistance paper: paired ctDNA (n=44) at end of phase 1/2; treatment-emergent RAS-pathway alterations in 59%, mutant KRAS amplification in 36% (16/44), RTK 9%, MAPK 25%, PI3K 9%; no secondary KRAS mutations (unlike G12C-off inhibitors). Preclinical: KRAS/MYC amplification, RTK upregulation; daraxonrasib + DDRi, + RTKi, or + zoldonrasib averted resistance.
entries.title: Acquired resistance to the RAS(ON) multi-selective inhibitor daraxonrasib guides rational combination therapy strategies in pancreatic cancer

entries.notes: Multi-stroma co-culture (PSCs, mixed fibroblasts, mesothelial cells + organoids) with scRNA-seq: stromal input required for in-vivo-like inflammatory program activation in PDAC malignant cells; ECM-associated and inflammatory signatures enriched in PDAC organoids relative to pancreatitis. Directly validates the thesis conclusion that CAF monoculture misses drug effects visible in co-culture.
entries.title: Multi-stromal organoid co-culture modelling reveals epithelial–fibroblast heterogeneity in pancreatic cancer and pancreatitis

entries.notes: Elraglusib (GSK-3β inhibitor) + daraxonrasib synergistic in murine KPC and human PDX-derived PDAC models, including FOLFIRINOX-resistant models. Supports rational-combination angle for resistant-line thesis work.
entries.title: Actuate announces preclinical synergy of elraglusib with zoldonrasib (RMC-9805) and daraxonrasib (RMC-6236) in PDAC

entries.notes: G12D-selective zoldonrasib + multi-selective daraxonrasib combination enters phase 3 first-line; mirrors the Nature Medicine finding that zoldonrasib combos avert daraxonrasib resistance preclinically.
entries.title: RASolute 309: Phase 3 of zoldonrasib + daraxonrasib vs chemotherapy in newly diagnosed metastatic PDAC

entries.notes: Moves RAS-targeted therapy into first-line; supports GI-102 first-line data (ORR 58%, DCR 90% reported at AACR 2026). Regulatory momentum item.
entries.title: FDA grants Breakthrough Therapy Designation to daraxonrasib + gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel in first-line metastatic pancreatic cancer

entries.notes: RAS inhibitor + 21h10 (AI-designed IL-21 mimic) primed CD4 T cells -> IFN-g -> macrophage tumor killing in mouse PDAC; human PDAC CD4 T cells respond to 21h10. Resistance-relevant: converts transient RASi response to durable remission.
entries.title: CD4 T cells convert transient responses to KRAS inhibition to durable remissions in pancreatic cancer

entries.notes: SLS009 increased apoptosis >6x vs daraxonrasib in MYC-amplified daraxonrasib-resistant patient-derived PDAC organoid; SLS009+daraxonrasib combo increased apoptosis to 36.5% and necrosis to 30.6%. MYC amplification is a recognized RASi resistance mechanism - directly relevant to the resistance-dataset survey and resistant-line thesis.
entries.title: SELLAS presents SLS009 (tambiciclib, CDK9 inhibitor) activity in MYC-amplified daraxonrasib-resistant PDAC organoids at AACR

entries.notes: Poster B011 (Kugel lab, Fred Hutch): HMGA2 drives IL-1a -> activates fibroblasts and immune cells into an immunosuppressive TME in basal-like PDAC; RAS inhibition alone left the immune barrier intact, IL1RAP blockade receded suppressive myeloid and fibroblast populations. Fibroblast/CAF angle: supports her thesis premise that CAF programs persist under RAS inhibition.
entries.title: Cantargia highlights preclinical data supporting nadunolimab (anti-IL1RAP) + RAS inhibition in PDAC at AACR

entries.notes: Predates radar; added to seen-list for dedup. PSN1 cells treated with DMSO / tazemetostat / RMC-6236 / combo; SASP gene activation as KRASi-sensitizing combo strategy. East China Normal University.
entries.title: ChIP-seq analysis of H3K27ac changes in pancreatic cancer cells treated with EZH2 and KRAS inhibitors

entries.notes: Predates radar; added to seen-list for dedup. KPC tumors treated with RMC-6236 +/- tazemetostat, CD45+ scRNA-seq.
entries.title: Single-cell RNA-seq analysis of immune microenvironment changes in pancreatic cancer following combined EZH2 and KRAS inhibition

entries.notes: KIT: inactivating CD44 in CAFs cut ECM production and cytokine release, lost immunosuppression, shrank tumors in mouse model; reprogramming (not depleting) CAFs. Direct CAF/ECM thesis angle; ties to existing CD44v6 peptide program.
entries.title: Loss of CD44 reeducates pancreatic cancer-associated fibroblasts modulating their fibrotic and immunosuppressive functions

entries.notes: Phase 1/2 TNG462-C102 (NCT06922591): vopimetostat (PRMT5 inhibitor, TNG462) + daraxonrasib in MTAP-deleted RAS-mutant pretreated mPDAC: 82% ORR (18/22), 100% DCR, 9-mo PFS 88%, median PFS not reached. Chemo-free combo; registrational Phase 3 in first-line MTAP-deleted PDAC planned H1 2027. Small non-randomized study; ORR down from 92% interim in 12 pts.
entries.title: Vopimetostat plus daraxonrasib yields 82% ORR in MTAP-deleted PDAC

entries.notes: Roswell Park: resistant cells sustain cell-cycle progression despite KRAS suppression; CDK4/6 cotargeting -> G1 arrest, CDK2 cotargeting -> broader durable cytostatic response; both gave durable in-vivo control in acquired-resistance xenografts. Defines sustained cell cycle as the common resistance vulnerability.
entries.title: Targeting distinct cell-cycle nodes overcomes RAS inhibitor resistance

entries.notes: Review synthesizing daraxonrasib structural biology, pharmacology, clinical data and resistance landscape; includes daraxonrasib+afatinib+STAT3-degrader triple with >200-day resistance-free regressions in PDAC GEMMs/PDXs, plus mTORC1/CDK4+CDK2 resistance nodes.
entries.title: Daraxonrasib and the era of pan-RAS inhibition: mechanisms, clinical advances, and resistance landscapes

entries.notes: Review: UPR (IRE1a, PERK, ATF6) as modulator of tumor-immune communication; ER stress upregulates PD-L1 via IRE1a RNase (incl. pancreatic lines), BiP stabilizes PD-L1, IRE1a-XBP1s represses MICA; HA15+anti-PD-1 boosted CD8 infiltration in mice. Pan-cancer review with PDAC examples; useful UPR-branch framing for the thesis.
entries.source: Journal of Cellular and Molecular Medicine
entries.title: The unfolded protein response as a modulator of cancer-immune cell communication in the tumour microenvironment

entries.notes: Predates radar window; added to seen-list for dedup, not reported this run. Sympathetic nerve-CAF crosstalk: sympathetic signaling enhanced CAF activation and ECM remodeling; activated CAFs induced nerve-injury programs in neurons; denervation reduced tumor size in female mice.
entries.title: Sympathetic nerve-fibroblast crosstalk drives nerve injury, fibroblast activation, and matrix remodeling in pancreatic cancer
